g.text: CS Student • Full Stack Developer • Computer Vision Explorer
I build modern web apps, experiment with AI-powered systems, and turn ideas into real, usable products.
Hey! I'm Vajeeda — a Computer Science student specializing in Cloud Computing, with a strong interest in Full Stack Web Development,
Computer Vision, and AI-driven applications. I enjoy building end-to-end solutions — from OCR-based reminder systems and real-time
traffic prediction models to responsive, production-ready web apps. I'm driven by curiosity, clean design, and solving real-world problems
Always learning. Always building. Always improving.
│ AREA │ WHAT I'M WORKING ON │ TOOLS & TECH │
│ Full Stack Dev │ Building scalable, end-to-end web applications │ React, Next.js, Node.js, Express │
│ Computer Vision │ Object detection, image preprocessing, CV pipelines │ OpenCV, Python, NumPy │
│ Cloud & Deployment │ Deploying and managing production-ready applications │ AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel │
│ Backend & APIs │ REST APIs, authentication, database integration │ FastAPI, Flask, Supabase, PostgreSQL │
│ Frontend Design │ Clean, responsive, user-centric interfaces │ Tailwind CSS, Figma │
│ Data & AI │ ML models and data-driven problem solving │ Pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost │
$ echo "Thanks for stopping by — feel free to explore my repositories"
